Title: Public preview: Database watcher for Azure SQL

Body.Content:
With database watcher, you can enable advanced monitoring of your Azure SQL resources in minutes. Detailed database performance and health data is delivered in near real time into a central data store and visualized on single-pane-of-glass dashboards in the Azure portal.
 
Explore detailed performance and configuration data to detect, investigate, and troubleshoot a wide variety of database performance and health problems. Find and resolve resource bottlenecks and right-size your Azure SQL resources for optimal price and performance.
 
Use the power of Azure Data Explorer and Real-Time Analytics in Microsoft Fabric to analyze SQL monitoring data on demand; build custom monitoring dashboards and visualizations in Power BI, Grafana, and other data visualization platforms.

Learn more.
